plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Mathematics, BA, plan LAMATBA, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention).
